summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals Inc. (TSX:EPRX, NASDAQ:EPRX) filed a Form 6-K furnishing press release and voting results from its June 18, 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. All seven management-nominated directors were elected with overwhelming support (99.8%+ for most), and KPMG LLP was re-appointed auditor. The filing confirms routine governance – no forced board departures, no transaction, no strategic review. As a non-US foreign private issuer, this 6-K equates to a proxy results report under US rules. No special-situation elements exist; the 'Management Changes' tag applies only because the election itself is the sole event, but confidence is low as it is purely routine annual meeting business.
